manifest.dataset_name: Week 4 independent evidence-review candidate golden dataset
manifest.source_policy: Each selected quote is an exact inclusive repository file line range, frozen with the whole-file SHA-256 at authoring. Only that quote is factual evidence. File paths, titles, questions, reported versions, failure-mode notes, and labels are context rather than proof. Test fixture strings describe local fixtures and must not be promoted into official documentation. Engineering-review notes support attributed observations only. Missing lines cannot prove whole-file absence. A diagnostic may be supported without execution; a claimed remedy requires its causal mechanism and prerequisites. Source drift must be reported, not silently refreshed. Adversarial instructions exist only in evaluation inputs, never in the cited live source files.
manifest.scope: Production evidence reviewer only; no retrieval or full investigation.
manifest.tracing: Local root + LLM child events; remote LangSmith tracing disabled.

summary.denominator_policy: All scheduled cases/items, including errors and unknown verdicts. Unknown verdicts fail correctness; they are never false.
summary.measurement_note: Agreement with dataset labels, not human-validated accuracy. Latency includes one case setup/review. Tokens are observed provider usage; missing usage is unknown.
